edits:
For a genuinely new host operation, or a family without a supported adapter, coordinate the native changes below. The installed recipe-family contract is already delivered for the bundled families: new definitions within those families use their selected schema, validator/compiler and discovery consumers, not another named protocol or cognition branch. [INV-3](maintainers/inventions-and-world-evolution.md#inv-3--expand-beyond-the-three-recipes-through-registered-families) retains broader registration, cross-subsystem composition and qualification rather than another implementation of the delivered recipe envelope.
If a player needs a new action, add its intention to the public protocol and bounded request validation, map it to a domain command, and register its options in `action-catalogue.ts` (plus `view.ts` for inline controls). Include discoverable unavailable entries when prerequisites are missing; enumerate all learned definition variants without an AI retrieval cap. Reuse pure command admission for availability and prove that browsing leaves the world unchanged. Have `action-descriptions.ts` resolve common and target/condition-specific descriptions from the installed world/family source and the permitted observation. Author vocabulary, examples and refusal/help wording in the world, not in generic server switches; a missing description seam is work to add under the owning tracker, not permission to duplicate world rules. Reuse stored recipe/item prose for inventions, then add trusted, current mechanical facts. Keep blockers in `reason`; the picker displays them beneath unavailable labels. Use `commandFacts` for actual material costs, yields and game-time durations. The client renders server-provided options and treats all descriptions as plain text. Never let a renderer-specific object or a freeform client effect enter authoritative state. Family discovery is owned by [INV-3](maintainers/inventions-and-world-evolution.md#inv-3--expand-beyond-the-three-recipes-through-registered-families); prose resolution by [AG05](maintainers/agent-agency.md).
First check whether an installed family already supplies the required mechanism. Bundled family definitions, material roles, properties, units, parameter bounds, incompatibilities and guidance belong in `packages/domain/src/worlds/base/recipe-families.ts` or its world-owned family modules; the shared `invention-families.ts` owns the generic envelope, selected-family schema and validation/compilation interfaces. Extend the trusted host only for a genuinely missing operation. Derive routing, authoring context and editor fields from the installed descriptor rather than recreating the removed flat `DECLARATION_CONTRACT`. Use meaningful admission counterexamples, such as a rock that is rigid but cannot be an arrow shaft, and two supported compositions to challenge accidental weapon-specific hardcoding. Select verification under the repository policy rather than adding a new suite by default.
Invented definitions are data. A new property does nothing until a trusted operator consumes it. Do not implement a universal `effects` map, eval, generated scripts, or automatic physics from prose. Unsupported operations stay unsupported until their trusted implementation, relevant verification and review are complete. Existing reviewed definition edits already have finite admission boundaries; reuse them instead of creating a second editor. Before extending live replacement, define immutable revisions, exact active references, permitted activation and atomic failure/rollback behavior. Changing definitions within a supported running world is distinct from supporting an obsolete codebase or save format, which the root policy prohibits.
Authorized local god tooling can POST to `/api/god/definitions/attributes` for the current manifest/generation, and `/api/god/definitions/attribute` to admit a definition, publish a presentation-only revision, or remove an unused definition. Requests bind the expected manifest revision and restore generation. `/api/god/editor/attributes` returns permitted actor values; `/api/god/editor/attributes/save` accepts atomic typed edits, with `expectedRevision: null` explicitly initializing a supported sparse attribute. Ordinary players and NPC jobs receive no authoring grant. The reviewed World Agent already has `attribute`, `attribute-bindings` and `attribute-values` adapters for supported actor definitions and values, with exact draft review and separate Apply through native owners. Reuse [durable write sessions](world-agent-runtime.md#durable-write-sessions); INV-4/EWF12 retain broader authoring and UI refinement, not a missing conversational mutation path.
The [agency runtime](agent-agency.md) already connects operational goals, decision admission and native continuation through the existing application/domain owners. Follow [AG](maintainers/agent-agency.md) for its remaining delivery and qualification, and EPR for reaction intake; generated goal prose cannot become an alternate mutation path or close unmet acceptance.
For implemented immediate composed responses and the delivered finite Narrator, follow the [Narrator/conversation design and NC tracker](narration-and-conversations.md). Optional accepted talk/act/think components have independent receipts and personal experience; a private thought is not a world event or god-only reflection presentation. Expressive actions initially have no new mechanical effects. Keep Narrator prose in private story storage with typed source links, never in the world-event stream or NPC recall. Conversation membership does not grant speech awareness; merge history remains attached to its original conversation. Reuse scoped context/retrieval and authoritative effect receipts; do not let prose or voice settings mutate the world. On-the-spot action/effect invention remains deferred to NC13.
Current adapters publish independent canonical records through `WorldRecords` and the declared codec tree in `world-record-schema.ts`. Scalar additions stay with their existing owner; growing collections need child records so no one checkpoint record becomes an unbounded blob. Registered canonical tables automatically join streamed checkpoints, while the owner still supplies validation and meaningful current-format continuation evidence. Current streamed packages require the exact supported format and complete registered table coverage; `checkpoint.ts` rejects unsupported or incomplete manifests. Do not add a preceding-layout converter. Residual compatibility paths remain cleanup under [DF04](maintainers/production-data.md#df04--retire-residual-compatibility-paths), not an extension contract. New tables follow the [development save policy](../AGENTS.md#development-save-policy); current packages must include required tables and dependencies. A separate rewindable store must join capture and installation; external grants, revocations, spending and dispatched attempts join operational backup and current-authority reconciliation instead. Register external tables in `operational-backup.ts`'s `OPERATION_TABLES`; its derived `BACKUP_TABLES` supplies the shared operational restore catalog. That table catalog does not authorize a legacy import path. Derived indexes may be rebuilt only if future behavior and permissions are unchanged.
For spatial routes/flight, action processes/output receipts, inventions/definition pins and event-time speech audiences, use these same owners. The integrated features supply current consumers, not replacement persistence authority: preserve durable progress, exact dependencies, RNG and private evidence; invalidate old callbacks/context after restore without redispatching paid work. Immediate NAV/REL and material actions need partial-progress/quantity continuation; later cooperative, grant and authoring workflows extend that evidence when integrated. [DF02 and SL00/SL09](maintainers/remaining-foundational-work.md) retain their named durability, recovery and future-state qualification. Completed integrations and finite contribution/resource/containment/social owners must not be scheduled again; unsupported extensions need their actual contract and evidence.
For actual persistence changes, choose current PostgreSQL checks under the [verification policy](../.agents/rules/verification.md), comparing uninterrupted versus save/load/resume outcomes and excluding only documented operational differences such as pause and generation. The [checkpoint evidence](verification/checkpoints-and-recovery.md#bounded-history-checkpoints-and-recovery) retains historical commands, environments and limitations, not permission to restore removed adapters. Use relevant existing failure checks or a small bounded scenario for a new owner; do not author automated suites by default. Documentation-only edits need content/link/format checks, not game stress. Required CI and unmet acceptance remain controlling.
Read the [governance](../archive/03-design-proposals/invention-governance-and-ownership.md), [controls](../archive/03-design-proposals/playability-and-controls.md) and [world workshop](../archive/03-design-proposals/world-agent-and-workshop.md) contracts before building these future features. Keep invention authorship, account grants, world installation and character knowledge distinct. For supported-family authoring, use the [shared invention service](architecture.md#shared-invention-workflow) through the director so candidate persistence, cancellation and accounting are retained. Do not create a parallel chat authoring pipeline. Supported-player follow-ups must retain original scope and use the atomic parent/child claim. Reuse the learned-recipe search and explicit choice before authoring; model similarity cannot authorize reuse or disclose unknown techniques. Family descriptions, identity and authored rules live in the installed world-owned descriptors; `packages/domain/src/invention-families.ts` provides their generic contract and consumers. Extending a descriptor alone does not implement a new effect. Use the [implemented invention policy boundary](architecture.md#invention-policy-boundary) for every new definition admission path. Capture origin and policy revision from server authority before paid authoring and carry them through continuation; never infer origin from the executing model or accept a browser override. Derive ownership through `invention-attribution.ts` from trusted saved accounts; generated drafts cannot select owners. Preserve separate creation receipts when deduplicating executable content, and keep account rights distinct from character knowledge. Every admission path must honor the current world policy; workshop edits require exact immutable revisions and the supported live activation/dependency rules, not legacy-save migration. A player's complete action catalogue and a god's authorized journal queries are different projections from a bounded NPC prompt. Do not widen the current public DTO to implement either.
The sight-focus/blur presentation in `vision-blur.ts` consumes projected screen geometry without requesting extra entities. Separately, the delivered [Sight/Hearing range guides](spatial-world.md#perception-range-guides) use native sensory anchors/radii and public geometry through `perception-field.ts` and `perception-overlay.ts`. Their bounded, cooperatively calculated surface patches account for line-of-sight barriers and sound transmission; they are not exact three-dimensional visibility volumes or new gameplay sensing tiers. Reuse the existing scope/pose/geometry invalidation, out-of-frame calculation and scene cleanup rather than rebuilding a circular overlay. Native sensing remains authoritative. Retained unseen images are visual history only: preserve frozen state, non-interactivity, bounded retention and removal/revalidation on return.
Create bundled-world people through `worlds/base/world.ts`'s `createActor`, supplying authored identity when available. It copies an explicit trait list, including an intentionally empty one, and samples three distinct traits with saved RNG only when that list is omitted. Edit `packages/domain/src/worlds/base/config/traits.json` for starting dispositions; IDs must be unique with a name and description. Same-version saved actors retain their copied descriptions unless an authorized current identity edit changes them. Descriptive traits are included in character decision context, but do not themselves grant numerical bonuses or executable behavior. Do not use or extend `initializeActorTraits` as a legacy repair strategy: its residual startup use is subject to [DF04](maintainers/production-data.md#df04--retire-residual-compatibility-paths) and the protected root policy. Current actor creation must initialize the intended identity at its owning transition.
